description: This file contains benchmarking code for Orleans grains, specifically for stateless worker grains, including setup, teardown, benchmark execution, and statistics collection. It defines interfaces, classes for grains, and benchmarking constants.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerBenchmark
classes.description: Main class for setting up and running performance benchmarks on Orleans grains, managing host lifecycle, and collecting statistics.

classes.name: BenchmarkConstants
classes.description: Contains benchmarking configuration constants such as max workers limit and process delay.

classes.name: IProcessorGrain
classes.description: Interface representing a grain that can process work asynchronously.

classes.name: IAdaptiveGrain
classes.description: Marker interface for adaptive grains, extending IProcessorGrain.

classes.name: IMonotonicGrain
classes.description: Marker interface for monotonic grains, extending IProcessorGrain.

classes.name: SWMonotonicGrain
classes.description: Stateless worker grain implementing IMonotonicGrain, used for benchmarking monotonic worker behavior.

classes.name: SWAdaptiveGrain
classes.description: Stateless worker grain implementing IAdaptiveGrain, used for benchmarking adaptive worker behavior.

classes.name: BaseGrain<T>
classes.description: Abstract base class for grains, managing worker count statistics, activation/deactivation, and common processing logic.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerBenchmark
methods.description: Constructor initializing Orleans host and grain factory.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Stops the Orleans host and disposes resources.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Executes benchmark tests for monotonic and adaptive grains.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Performs a specific benchmark run on a grain, managing workload, stats collection, and cooldown periods.
